plays.story: Binance's record $6.3B hack (traced to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, an engineer's compromised laptop, and EIP-7702 exploitation) rattles both markets and infosec circles.

angles.itsalreadypriced: Title: 'Binance Got Robbed of $6.3B—Here's Why BNB Crashed, Bitcoin Dipped Under $77K, and RUNE Mooned 13%.' Trace the market fallout: BNB -8%, stolen BTC now exceeds Tesla's treasury, Binance's $6.34B matching-funds promise, and what it means for exchange-held assets going into year-end.
angles.itsalreadywhen: Title: 'The Engineer's Laptop That Cost Binance $6.3 Billion.' Break down the actual attack chain—compromised credentials vs. private key theft, how EIP-7702 amplified the damage, and why North Korea's TraderTraitor crew keeps winning against billion-dollar security budgets.

plays.story: A hardware implant discovered in Trezor Safe 5 wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis exposes a physical supply-chain attack on crypto cold storage.

angles.itsalreadypriced: Title: 'Your Hardware Wallet May Already Be Compromised.' Explain what the Trezor Safe 5 implant means for holders—how to check your device, which reseller channel is implicated, and why 'cold storage' isn't automatically safe storage.
angles.itsalreadywhen: Title: 'Hackers Don't Need Your Password If They Can Mail You a Backdoor.' Use the Trezor implant as a case study in physical/supply-chain security, tying it to the same week's GitHub-issue supply-chain campaign and 61 compromised repos—supply chain attacks are now hitting hardware, not just code.

plays.story: Clive Barker's Hellraiser is becoming a tabletop RPG, designed by the creator of The One Ring.

angles.bizzal-games: Title: 'What Will a Hellraiser TTRPG Even Play Like? Betting on The One Ring Designer's Pinhead Problem.' Speculate on mechanics—how do you gamify Cenobite bargains and body horror without it becoming a straight horror-survival clone, drawing on the designer's known systems.
angles.itsalreadywritten: Title: 'From Cenobites to Character Sheets: What Licensing Hellraiser Says About Horror IP's TTRPG Gold Rush.' Frame this alongside Paizo's Re-Animator license as evidence that classic horror cinema is becoming the next big TTRPG licensing wave, and what that means for narrative design.

plays.story: D&D's World of Warcraft crossover book reveals all 16 playable species but gets hit with a North American release delay.

angles.bizzal-games: Title: 'All 16 WoW Species Are Coming to D&D—Here's Which Ones Will Actually Break Your Campaign.' Dig into the mechanical balance questions: which Azeroth races translate cleanly to 5E stat blocks and which ones (looking at you, Worgen) are going to wreck encounter math.
angles.itsalreadywritten: Title: 'Azeroth Meets Faerûn, and the Book Is Already Late: What the D&D x WoW Delay Says About Crossover Worldbuilding.' Explore the narrative challenge of merging two decades-deep lore machines into one coherent setting, and why that complexity might be exactly what's slowing the release.
